bullets.title: Chemical composition analysis of 102 ayahuasca brews
bullets.note: This is a great thread on (1) the difficulty of treating ayahuasca as a singular, standardized medicine and (2) the importance of collaborating with indigenous healers whose botanical knowledge far exceeds our limited grasp of these species. Brew method is another huge variable.

bullets.title: Stutz
bullets.note: This doc was recommended to me by multiple friends, and it does a beautiful job of sharing both a loving relationship and effective therapeutic tools for changing your life. I was hesitant to watch this at first. I worried that it might dredge up old, painful personal issues that I feel I’ve spent enough time on, but it didn’t open Pandora’s box at all. As my friends correctly reassured me, it’s nothing but upside. Here’s the official description: “In candid conversations with actor [Jonah Hill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonah_Hill), leading psychiatrist [Phil Stutz](https://www.thetoolsbook.com/about-phil-and-barry) explores his early life experiences and unique, visual model of therapy.” Watch the trailer [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UKCmefQdplI).

bullets.title: Second MAPS-Sponsored Phase 3 Trial of MDMA-Assisted Therapy for PTSD Completed
bullets.note: This is the first time a pivotal and confirmatory Phase 3 trial has been completed for a psychedelic therapy. Moreover, more than 12 million people in the U.S. alone suffer from the debilitating effects of PTSD, and it’s now estimated that before the end of 2024, these people will likely have access to MDMA-assisted psychotherapy as a novel treatment option. For those wondering why I’ve been personally involved with this for years and why this treatment fundamentally differs from conventional approaches, please [read this](https://tim.blog/2020/06/16/maps-capstone-challenge-mdma-ptsd/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), or watch [this documentary](https://tim.blog/2019/03/09/trip-of-compassion/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf).
